summary: The config lookup returns resolved Ansible configuration values from defaults, ansible.cfg, environment, CLI and variables (not keywords) for the current host; it cannot account for keywords or delegation.
questions: How do I read an Ansible configuration setting from within a playbook?
How do I see all available config settings?
Does the config lookup account for playbook keywords?

answer_card.title: config lookup
answer_card.answer_md:
`lookup('ansible.builtin.config', 'SETTING')` returns a setting's resolved value from defaults, `ansible.cfg`, environment, CLI and variables (**not keywords**), in the context of the current host.

It can't account for keywords or delegation, so for those options it's only an approximation. Use `ansible-config list` (add `-t all` for plugin options) to see available settings.
